item.title: Nvidia Q3 Revenue Doubles to $115.8B as CEO Huang Resigns Amid Scandal
item.description:
Nvidia Q3 Revenue Doubles to $115.8B as CEO Huang Resigns Amid Scandal

Nvidia reported third-quarter revenue of $115.8 billion, more than double the prior year, while its stock plunged nearly 40 percent from an October high following the resignation of cofounder and CEO Jensen Huang amid allegations of extramarital affairs and a Chinese espionage plot.

📊 Q3 Financial Results

  • Revenue more than doubled year over year to $115.8 billion
  • Data center revenue increased 110 percent
  • Results exceeded Wall Street expectations
  • Nearly $20 billion in revenue came from the Vera Rubin platform

🖥️ Vera Rubin Platform

  • Shipped during the quarter
  • Described as the “fastest product ramp in company history” by Kress
  • Generated nearly $20 billion in revenue

📉 Stock Price Volatility

  • All-time high reached on October 6
  • October 29: closed at $213.66, down 0.8 percent
  • October 30: closed with a 4 percent drop as Nasdaq fell 2.9 percent
  • November 4: continued decline amid midterm election concerns
  • November 5: fell 9.2 percent, largest single-day drop in at least a year
  • November 6: rose 2.8 percent to $186.64
  • November 9: tumbled 7 percent at open, volume surged past three-month average
  • November 10: closed at $168.89, nearly 10 percent below last trading day of 2025
  • November 11: rebounded slightly then plunged again on ouster reports
  • November 12: fell nearly 14 percent at open, closed with 4.3 percent dip, intraday low $148.80 (lowest in a year)
  • By Thursday (November 12) hovering around $150, wiping out post-earnings pop from Tuesday night

🧑‍💼 Leadership Crisis

  • October 29: The New York Times reported U.S. intelligence believed Huang was target of Chinese espionage plot
  • Plot centered on “close relationship” with Alice Huang, Chinese national and executive at Megaspeed (Singapore data center company, Nvidia client)
  • November 8: Huang sent company-wide memo apologizing for extramarital affair
  • Memo coincided with independent board investigation into alleged misconduct and potential compromise of company secrets or national security
  • November 11: media reports indicated board considering ousting Huang; second alleged affair with Nvidia employee emerged
  • November 12: Nvidia announced Huang’s departure
  • Harvey Jones appointed chairman of the board; stated company “does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO” and retained executive search firm for replacement
  • Huang cofounded Nvidia in 1993 and led it without a succession plan

🏛️ Congressional Hearings

  • December 1: Huang scheduled for transcribed interviews before House Foreign Affairs Committee, Select Committee on the Chinese Communist Party, and House Intelligence Committee
  • December 2: Nvidia general counsel scheduled for same committees

🤖 Anthropic Debut

  • Anthropic, a major Nvidia customer, made Nasdaq debut at $111.50 per share — 34 percent higher than expected

#Nvidia #JensenHuang #VeraRubin #AIChips #StockMarket #CongressionalHearings

item.title: Nvidia Posts $65 B Quarterly Profit, Promises Massive Cash Returns After CEO Exit
item.description:
Nvidia Posts $65 B Quarterly Profit, Promises Massive Cash Returns After CEO Exit

Nvidia reported a record‑breaking quarter of profit and cash flow, and interim CEO Colette Kress announced plans to return all excess free cash flow to shareholders following co‑founder Jensen Huang’s resignation.

📊 Financial Highlights

  • Nvidia is “raking in $700 million in profit a day on average.”
  • Quarterly profit reached $65.3 billion, outpacing the $37.7 billion, $29.8 billion and $55.3 billion profits of Micron, SK Hynix and Samsung respectively.
  • Annual “pure profit” exceeds $200 billion.
  • “That’s how much pure profit Nvidia now makes.”
  • Projected revenue for the next quarter is $130 billion.
  • Gross margins are expected to dip to 71–72 %, with a target of 73 % next year.
  • Market‑cap fell from around $5 trillion to $3.6 trillion.
  • Share price is expected to clear $45,000 and change.
  • A $1,000 investment ten years ago is now worth over $67,000; a $15,000 investment then would be over $1 million today.
  • Nvidia could give a $1 million bonus to each of its 42,000 employees every three months without exhausting cash.

🗣️ Executive Statements

  • “Going forward, we intend to return all excess free cash flow net of strategic uses to shareholders,” Colette Kress announced.
  • “All” is “a lot more than the 50 percent baseline that Jensen promised five months ago.”
  • “From a business perspective, it’s business as usual,” she said.
  • She added that Nvidia has secured backing from customers and suppliers, “including TSMC, the all‑important firm that actually fabricates Nvidia’s chips.”

⚔️ Competitive Landscape

  • “I want to show you that Nvidia has risen so far, so fast, that rival chipmakers AMD, Intel, and Qualcomm barely qualify as competition now.”
  • In the DRAM market, Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron control nearly 90 % of capacity, yet each falls short of Nvidia’s quarterly profit.
  • Both Micron and SK Hynix lost money in 2023 because they “produced too much memory.”

💡 Why It Matters

  • The scale of Nvidia’s cash generation enables unprecedented shareholder returns and employee bonuses.
  • Even after a sharp market‑cap decline, the company’s profit growth shows the AI‑driven data‑center demand remains strong.
  • The firm’s relationship with TSMC ensures continued supply of its leading‑edge GPUs.

#Nvidia #AI #Finance #Semiconductors

Source: Nvidia’s rise, visualized

item.title: Anthropic Confirms IPO Target at Valuation Up to $1.4 Trillion
item.description:
Anthropic Confirms IPO Target at Valuation Up to $1.4 Trillion

Anthropic confirmed on Tuesday that its upcoming initial public offering could be one of the largest ever, despite falling short of earlier valuation expectations.

⚙️ Key details

  • Share Price: Expected to be between $70.00 and $78.00 per share.
  • Valuation: According to the New York Times, the pricing would value the company as high as $1.4 trillion. Reuters noted that the IPO was previously expected to reach a valuation of up to $2 trillion.
  • Stock Market Listing: Anthropic has applied to list its Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker symbol “ANT.”
  • Expected Timeline: Sources told The Wall Street Journal that Anthropic is aiming for shares to begin trading next week on Thursday or Friday.
  • Competitor Comparison: As of last week, rival AI company OpenAI was valued at $1.25 trillion.

💡 Context and influencing factors

The reduced expectations surrounding the IPO follow several recent market and political pressures:

  • Months of ongoing debate regarding AI safety.
  • Midterm election results showing souring public opinion toward AI companies and the large-scale data center projects they heavily invest in.
  • Weekend revelations concerning an alleged Chinese spy’s involvement with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

Upon going public, Anthropic’s offering is expected to make it one of the world’s most valuable publicly traded companies as early as next week.

#Anthropic #IPO #Nasdaq #OpenAI #ArtificialIntelligence

Source: Anthropic targets $1.4 trillion IPO

item.title: Tech Sector Volatility Stems From AI Concerns Amid Rising Borrowing Costs
item.description:
Tech Sector Volatility Stems From AI Concerns Amid Rising Borrowing Costs

The week‑end markets showed a clear split: broad indices posted modest gains while the technology sector faced selling pressure linked to worries about artificial intelligence and higher borrowing costs.

🔍 Overview

  • Volatility was mainly driven by selling pressure in the tech sector due to concerns around AI and borrowing costs.
  • The NZX 50 gained approximately 0.50 % over the week.
  • The All Ordinaries rose about 0.26 %, with Australian REITs among the strongest sectors while technology shares declined.
  • In the United States, the Dow increased 0.93 % and the Nasdaq 0.64 %.
  • The FTSE 100 climbed 0.85 %, helped by easing UK government bond yields and strong mining shares.
  • The Shanghai Composite fell 0.74 %, trading only two sessions after the Golden Week holiday.

📉 Market Impact of AI Concerns

  • Tech‑focused investors reacted to headlines about AI, contributing to a sell‑off despite overall market upticks.
  • The broader market sentiment remained relatively subdued, with the NZX 50 only gaining around half a percent and the All Ordinaries showing modest growth.
  • Mixed sector performance highlighted that while some areas (e.g., REITs, mining) performed well, technology lagged due to the AI‑related risk perception.

💡 Why It Matters

  • Investor Sentiment: The AI narrative is now a factor in short‑term market moves, influencing risk appetite in the tech segment.
  • Borrowing Costs: Rising interest rates amplify concerns, as higher borrowing costs can affect AI‑driven business models that often rely on significant capital investment.
  • Future Outlook: Continued monitoring of AI news and monetary‑policy signals will be crucial for gauging whether tech volatility persists or eases.

item.title: onsemi revises Synaptics acquisition to $5.7B all‑cash deal, boosting AI‑related power strategy
item.description:
onsemi revises Synaptics acquisition to $5.7B all‑cash deal, boosting AI‑related power strategy

onsemi (NASDAQ: ON) announced a revised acquisition of Synaptics that is expected to accelerate growth in AI‑related power solutions.

🔍 Overview

  • onsemi changed its proposed acquisition of Synaptics to an approximately $5.7 billion all‑cash transaction after a competing bid emerged.
  • The revised structure is viewed as more shareholder‑friendly and supports the company’s AI and power‑management strategy.

💰 Deal Structure

  • Lowers the deal cost by about $1.3 billion.
  • Avoids equity dilution.
  • Expected to provide more immediate earnings accretion.

🤖 AI & Power Strategy

  • Management is positioning Synaptics’ connectivity and edge‑computing capabilities to complement onsemi’s power semiconductors.
  • The combined business targets physical AI, automotive and industrial applications.
  • Investors see the transaction as a way to broaden exposure beyond cyclical semiconductor demand.

📈 Market Reaction

  • Shares increased as investors focused on the revised deal.
  • The stock recently traded near $86.31, below its 200‑day moving average of $88.79 but well above its 52‑week low.
  • Positive sentiment: Deal viewed as shareholder‑friendly and supportive of AI strategy.
  • Neutral sentiment: Technical momentum improved; market commentary points to a potential higher low near $68, rising volume and a possible breakout confirmation above roughly $86.50.
  • Negative sentiment: Analyst caution remains. Stifel raised its price target to $80 from $75 but kept a Hold rating, noting that inventory correction is largely complete while demand recovery is uncertain. The new target is below the recent trading level.
  • Negative sentiment: Insider selling is a secondary concern; recent disclosures show executives sold shares, including CFO Trent Thad’s reported sales of about 90,000 shares.

item.title: Strategy Inc. expands Bitcoin holdings and cash reserves amid market volatility
item.description:
Strategy Inc. expands Bitcoin holdings and cash reserves amid market volatility

Strategy Inc. (NASDAQ: MSTR) has been in the spotlight as its stock volatility reflects the interplay between Bitcoin price movements, analyst targets, and corporate treasury actions.

📈 Market Activity

  • Bitcoin climbed above $86,000‑$87,000, boosting Strategy as a leveraged Bitcoin proxy.
  • Investors bought 584,635 call options, about 21% above average daily call volume, indicating positioning for further upside while also raising short‑term volatility risk.
  • Despite the rally, the stock later decreased as investors took profits after a sharp monthly advance.

💰 Treasury Moves

  • Strategy disclosed the purchase of 1,665 Bitcoin for roughly $143 million, bringing total holdings to 847,666 BTC.
  • The company repurchased about $152 million of its STRC preferred stock, signaling ongoing capital‑management activity.
  • It holds $5.02 billion in cash reserves to cover preferred dividends and debt interest.
  • A transfer of 3,568 BTC (≈ $300 million) between wallets was recorded; the move was not identified as a sale but raised questions about custody, financing, or treasury‑management activity.

📊 Analyst Outlook

  • Citigroup raised its MSTR price target to $240, citing a higher Bitcoin forecast of $113,000 and improved valuation assumptions.
  • Bitcoin Standard author Saifedean Ammous noted that rival Bitcoin‑treasury companies may struggle to match Strategy’s scale, cash reserves, and funding model.

⚠️ Risks & Index Exposure

  • A proposed MSCI “non‑operating company” rule could remove Strategy from major indexes, potentially triggering up to $2.8 billion in MSCI‑linked forced selling.
  • The company’s dependence on Bitcoin prices, preferred‑dividend obligations, and financing conditions makes the stock highly sensitive to crypto reversals.

📊 Sentiment Snapshot

  • News sentiment for MSTR over the past 7 days is 0.63, compared with an average technology news sentiment of 0.50.
